Deus Ex Collection
If you haven't played the Deus Ex series I'd highly recommend buying this. You'll probably want to mod the first two games so that they look better, as they're pretty old.

You can skip playing DX: The Fall, it's terrible and doesn't add anything to the storyline. I've included videos for everything besides Invisible War, which is rather controversial. A lot of people thought it was a bad game, and it's very console-oriented, but story-wise it adds a lot to the series.

 

Receiver
This is a really cool game that's all about reloading realistic guns. You have to actually pull out the clip, load the bullets manually, etc. This is more enjoyable than it sounds and becomes intuitive pretty quickly.

One improvement I'd really like is the ability to choose which gun you want to use, rather than having a random one picked at the start of the game. It's very challenging, and even with one gun it would take you a long time to find the collectables and win this game. One shot from an enemy turret and you're dead and start over.

 

Race The Sun
A solid flying/racing game where you're trying to dodge obstacles and keep going fast enough that the sun doesn't pass over the horizon and leave your solar-powered vehicle without power. The difficulty controls your speed, and faster is more fun in my opinion!

 

Quantum Conundrum
I was hoping for another good Portal type game, but this one had a lot of rough edges and wasn't compelling enough to really draw me in. It looks cute, a pity the gameplay wasn't as stellar.

 

Bridge Constructor Medieval
This has more game-type mechanics than other bridge building games, sometimes asking you to construct bridges that will collapse as your enemies cross them, etc. I enjoyed those parts, although it still wasn't enough of the game for me to recommend it highly - unless you really enjoy bridge building.

 

PixelJunk Monsters Ultimate
I love tower defense games, and didn't think this one was very good - it doesn't give you indications of the enemies path, etc - but other people seem to love it. I suspect they're playing it on mobile though, because there are a lot of better TD games for the PC.

 

DLC Quest
A short and sarcastic game mocking all the DLC practices we take for granted now. It's incredibly well done and definitely worth picking up for the current sale price of $0.74

 

SPAZ
This is a pretty solid space shooter. TB's voice acting leaves a bit to be desired, but overall it's a pleasant experience, and has a bit more humor than similar games.

 

Dark
I was hoping for a vampire-themed game that played like Dishonored, and while this did have some similar abilities it was ruined by bugs, atrocious voice acting, and rough gameplay.

 

Port Royale 3
This one wasn't exactly a pirate game to me, but the part that really worked well was the trading - setting up trade routes and businesses in the towns was fantastic and enjoyable.

 

Sleeping Dogs
I know there's a storyline, but my favorite part of this game was just roaming around the massive city. You can drive for an insanely long time without seeing the same scenery, and that's incredibly relaxing and enjoyable.

The combat isn't your normal shooting either, it's combined with martial arts combos and fist-fights, so the experience is somewhat unique. Not your standard GTA type game.

 

Tomb Raider
This is a pretty great prequel to the Tomb Raider story in my opinion, although I'm not a hardcore fan of the series. The gameplay was solid and the story fit well, with the exception of the voice actress whinging a bit much at times. (if you're familiar with her on-screen acting you'll immediately see it's just her personality coming through)
